title: Open/closed recollement for condensed coefficient modules
statement: Use [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] with complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ assumed quasi-compact as a morphism (for every affine open $W\subseteq X$, the intersection $U\cap W$ is quasi-compact), and let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring sheaf on profinite sets with the finite jointly surjective topology. Put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ for $T=X,U,Z$ using [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], and write $D^+(T,\Lambda)$ for complexes of $\Lambda_T$-module sheaves with cohomology zero in all sufficiently negative degrees in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. On these categories there are adjunctions $j_!\dashv j^*\dashv Rj_*$ and $i^*\dashv i_*\dashv Ri^!$, natural in their arguments. The functors $j^*,j_!,i^*,i_*$ come from exact functors on module sheaves. The pullbacks $j^*,i^*$ preserve all small colimits of sheaves; $i_*$ is fully faithful and $i^*i_*\cong\mathrm{id}$. The functor $Ri^!$ is left t-exact: $K\in D^{\geq a}(X,\Lambda)$ implies $Ri^!K\in D^{\geq a}(Z,\Lambda)$. There are natural distinguished triangles $j_!j^*K\to K\to i_*i^*K\to j_!j^*K[1]$ and $i_*Ri^!K\to K\to Rj_*j^*K\to i_*Ri^!K[1]$, with maps given by the units and counits of these adjunctions. The functors, triangles and adjunction bijections commute with shifts. Functorial bounded-below injective-resolution models may be used for the right derived functors, with common lower bound $a$ when their inputs have this bound.

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-abelian-closed-support], whose supported-unit half is proved by joint restriction conservativity from the smaller closed-counit input. Lift the counit and supported-unit isomorphisms through the monoidal adjunction on module objects and the scalar-change equivalence. The coefficient pullback comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-point-pullback] identify the underlying inverse-image functors for [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. The open extension unit is invertible because the fully faithful abelian extension by zero linearizes, and scalar change is an equivalence.

Prove j* i_* = 0 by evaluating the underlying abelian direct image on the empty base change of every object over U. Derive i* j_! = 0 by the two adjunction Hom equivalences. The supported-unit assertion makes i* and j* jointly detect zero objects. For an epimorphism on Z, the cokernel of its direct image is killed by both restrictions: i* kills it by the invertible closed counit and j* kills it by j* i_* = 0. Hence direct image preserves epimorphisms, and its existing left exactness makes it exact.

For a module sheaf F construct S(F)=ker(F→j_*j*F), with maps given by kernel.map. Exact open restriction and the invertible open counit show j*S(F)=0. Closed support identifies S(F) with i_*i*S(F). Put i!F=i*S(F). Every map i_*B→F has zero composite with F→j_*j*F by the adjunction and j*i_*B=0. Its unique kernel factorization and full faithfulness of i_* yield the natural Hom equivalence Hom(B,i!F)≃Hom(i_*B,F). This constructs the right adjoint, which is additive and left exact.

Use the proved source-library bounded-below derived adjunction API to derive the exact adjunctions and the two right adjoints. Exact derived composition and counit isomorphisms give full faithfulness of closed pushforward and open extension. The right derived functors have shift structures induced by their left adjoints, with shift-compatible adjunctions. For the exact adjunctions, restrict the shift-compatible unbounded adjunction along the fully faithful bounded-below inclusions and use the canonical comparison isomorphisms. Right-derived homology vanishing proves left t-exactness.

Exact derived inverse images commute with homology. Therefore the two zero composites and joint detection of zero pass from sheaves to D+. Complete the closed unit, respectively the open counit, to a distinguished triangle. Each restriction kills the cone because it inverts the relevant arrow, so joint zero detection kills that cone. Thus ker(j*) is the essential image of derived i_* and ker(i*) is the essential image of derived j_!.

Apply the proved source-library theorem Pretriangulated.Recollement.existsUnique_distTriang_counit_unit twice, once with embedding j_! and once with embedding i_*. It supplies the connecting arrows for exactly the prescribed units and counits. The triangle-morphism axiom, together with uniqueness of those connecting arrows, proves naturality. Transport each triangle by the signed shift functor. The commutation isomorphisms and shift-compatible adjunctions identify its first two arrows with the prescribed shifted unit and counit; uniqueness identifies the third. The symmetry of shiftFunctorComm checks the sign in NatTrans.CommShift.

Construct functorial injective embeddings using the proved source-library K-injective replacement of complexes concentrated in degree zero and degree-zero evaluation; its augmentation is monic and its terms are injective. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-functorial-bounded-injective-resolution]. For a common cohomological lower bound a, first apply the canonical good truncation at a. Its projection is a quasi-isomorphism on such inputs and all its terms below a vanish. The resolution theorem preserves that strict bound. Injective complexes are right-acyclic for either left exact functor, so the actual right-derived resolution unit is invertible. Inverse images preserve small colimits by their ordinary adjunctions.
